summary: Controlled synthetic cloud trial review; not a production security certification. Auth, Rules, Admin SDK permissions, transitions, limits and maintenance tested. Runtime secrets excluded from clients and Git.

findings.issue: Basic per-UID/IP-hash minute limits exist. App Check is not enforced; anonymous UID rotation can evade UID limits. No operational anti-abuse assurance.
findings.recommendation: Keep controlled synthetic trials; configure App Check and monitoring before broader use.

findings.issue: Foreground listeners do not replace push/background delivery. No multi-wave redispatch.
findings.recommendation: Keep volunteer screen open during trials; implement and verify push/outbox before field use.

findings.issue: Private data becomes eligible after 24h; bounded daily cron can delay deletion beyond 24–48h. Historical audit/status data is retained.
findings.recommendation: Monitor worker and define complete retention/deletion policy before real data.

findings.issue: Datastore User key can access project data through Admin SDK and bypass Rules. Stored as Vercel backend secret only.
findings.recommendation: Rotate/revoke at end of trial; do not export to clients, EAS or Git.

findings.issue: Earlier 2026-10-21 audit reported upstream advisories; counts from v0.3 are historical, not a current scan.
findings.recommendation: Review reachable advisories and compatible SDK updates before public real-data use; do not force framework downgrades.
